name: orthomcl-kinase-groups-through-falciparum-proteins
turns: Take the ortholog groups that contain a protein with the protein kinase domain PF00069, keep only their Plasmodium falciparum 3D7 proteins, then give me the ortholog groups those proteins belong to.
rationale: Groups to proteins, an intersection with one organism's proteins, and proteins back to groups: the round trip returns the kinase groups that hold a 3D7 protein, the same groups as the kinase search intersected with a phyletic pattern that requires the 3D7 genome.

provenance.curatorNote: Both transforms and a protein-level intersection in one strategy.
